Pan with Ctrl/Cmd + left-drag and keep the creation buttons together.

- **Ctrl/Cmd + left-button drag** pans the board from empty space or a card. The content follows your hand, just like middle-button drag.
- **Ctrl/Cmd + click** still adds or removes a card from the selection. A small movement threshold keeps slight pointer jitter from becoming a pan, and a completed pan does not change the selection.
- **New thread** sits immediately before **New entry** in one group. Both buttons stay together when the toolbar wraps in a narrow window.
- Ordinary card dragging, middle-button pan, links, buttons and connection widgets keep their normal actions. Losing window focus cancels an unfinished pan.

The README includes the new gesture. Validation covers twenty-four unit tests, thirteen modifier-pan checks, seven existing pan checks, fifteen connection checks, and toolbar checks at 1200- and 640-pixel viewport widths in desktop Obsidian. Cmd was exercised as the Meta modifier on Windows; a physical Mac has not been tested. All original demo notes were preserved.

Requires Obsidian 1.10.2 or later. Install `main.js`, `manifest.json` and `styles.css` below. GitHub Actions builds, checks, attests and verifies all three files before publishing them.
